most_likely_next_acceptance.reason: Revision TK-NHN859 directly responds to each explicit feasibility request and is waiting for review. Remaining limitation: the cut-resistant sleeve/can-edge interaction has no reported physical cut-load trial.

next_candidates.reason: Revision TK-DNK9QG adds a reproducible spatula setup/reset and observable clearance check; only minor action-force ambiguity remains.
Revision TK-7BHUHG names the carrier/base and adds a persistent final ready-state check; a real half-latched sample remains conditional.
Revision TK-F2TUKF defines wear, projection, pull-off and retirement checks; wear-resistance target is still model-selected rather than population-grounded.

higher_risk_open_prs.risk: Current model slides a non-rotating wheel and does not squeeze tubing; central clinical construct is missing.
Reviewer requested evidence on real seating force; simulated peak is about 110 N and has not been measured on the selected cover.
Real thermal paste adhesion/release and hardware-model correspondence remain uncertain.
Task importance and machine-displacement scoring remain open review risks.
Still waiting on review; no newer feedback to target.
